page_title: HOF 4-3 RBL | Hoffenheim v RB Leipzig 23/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' The attendance for today's match is 28023.
90+2' Andre Silva (RB Leipzig) tries to get the ball up and over the defensive wall, but they easily block the effort.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Frank Willenborg shows a yellow card to Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) for his blatant foul.

87' 4 - 3 Goal – 4:3! Anton Stach sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim) rises above the defenders to meet the ball near the penalty spot and heads it straight into the left side of the goal.
86' Hoffenheim work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
86' Christian Ilzer decides to make a substitution. Alexander Prass will be replaced by Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim).
85' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.

82' 3 - 3 Goal! Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) neatly controls a decent pass from Jacob Bruun Larsen. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the bottom right corner from the edge of the box. 3:3.
82' It's time for a substitution. Andre Silva (RB Leipzig) comes on in place of Lois Openda.
81' Substitution. Tom Bischof makes way for Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim).
81' Christian Ilzer has decided to substitute Andrej Kramaric and he is replaced by Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim).
77' The manager makes a subsitution with Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) coming on for Kevin Kampl.
75' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) was quite harsh and Frank Willenborg didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
72' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
69' The resulting set piece from Hoffenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
67' 2 - 3 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 2:3.
64' The corner is swung in but RB Leipzig can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

63' Oliver Baumann pulls off a fantastic save! Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out. The referee blows his whistle, RB Leipzig are awarded a corner kick.
63' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
62' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and RB Leipzig manage to earn a corner.
61' Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Haris Tabakovic.
60' Marco Rose has decided to make a change. Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) replaces Arthur Vermeeren.
60' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Benjamin Sesko as he is replaced by Assan Ouedraogo (RB Leipzig).
55' Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim) gets on the end of a cross but produces a tame shot from the edge of the area which goes well wide of the right post.
50' 2 - 2 Fantastic goal! Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) again proved his ability to execute a free kick! His shot just floated in, grazing the left post on the way, and gave the keeper no chance!
50' Foul! Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Hoffenheim are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
48' Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Peter Gulacsi is alert and denies him.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) comes off for Lutsharel Geertruida.
46' Referee Frank Willenborg blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
42' Frank Willenborg blows for a foul after Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
41' The free kick from long range, taken by RB Leipzig, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

37' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Oliver Baumann shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
33' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
31' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
27' There's an opportunity for Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
27' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Hoffenheim win a corner.
24' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for RB Leipzig.

20' 1 - 2 Goal! Lois Openda puts Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) in the clear with just the keeper to beat. He takes his shot early from the edge of the box and scores beautifully into the top right corner. 1:2.

17' 1 - 1 Stunning strike! Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) latches on to a precise through ball from Alexander Prass before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the back of the net from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 1:1.
17' Frank Willenborg sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
17' The RB Leipzig players halt their celebrations as referee Frank Willenborg makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
16' 0 - 1 Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) meets a perfect cross from Antonio Nusa deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike inside the left post. It's 0:1.
14' The free kick from long range, taken by RB Leipzig, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

11' What a chance that is! Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes high over the crossbar!
9' Frank Willenborg interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig).
7' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Hoffenheim comes to nothing.

7' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block. The ball goes out for a corner. Hoffenheim can continue in their attacking effort.
5' Golden chance! Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
RB Leipzig will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Frank Willenborg.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
